title: Chai
transcript:
A steel tumbler, too hot to hold by the body. He holds it by the rim.
The same dent near the lip. The same smell of cardamom and boiled milk.

BHOSLE:
"Good morning, beta. Sleep well?"

BHOSLE:
"Good morning, beta. Sleep well?"

BHOSLE:
"Good morning, beta..."

The voice keeps coming, laid over itself, morning after morning.
Each one a little slower. A little more grey in it.
Forty mornings. One tumbler.

BHOSLE:
"Half past twelve I go for my lunch. Half an hour. Don't do anything stupid, haan?"
